info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Carrental Reservations Returns-v1-spec
info.description: The Carrental Reservation Returns API allows consumers to efficiently access and manage information regarding return details for car rental reservations. This endpoint supports retrieval of return data, which is crucial for rental agencies looking to track vehicle status and ensure timely return procedures. Typically utilized by car rental service providers and fleet management systems, this API streamlines operations related to the return of vehicles. It enables quick access to essential reservation information for customer service representatives and system integrations.

get.description: Fetch a list of return reservations for the user. This endpoint allows you to view all reservations that are marked for return, providing relevant details such as reservation ID, date, and status.

requestBody.description: Request body for returning a reservation. This payload should include the necessary details for processing the return request, adhering to the expected JSON schema.

204.description: Successfully processed the request with no content returned.
